parameters.query:
WITH linked AS (
  UPDATE rag_feedback feedback
  SET transaction_id = tx.transaction_id,
      matched = true,
      updated_at = now()
  FROM rag_transactions tx
  WHERE feedback.matched = false
    AND feedback.discord_response_message_id = tx.discord_response_message_id
  RETURNING feedback.feedback_id, feedback.transaction_id,
            feedback.discord_response_message_id, feedback.feedback_source,
            feedback.feedback_type, feedback.feedback_value
),
traced AS (
  INSERT INTO rag_trace_events (transaction_id, event_name, node_name, status, event_payload)
  SELECT transaction_id, 'feedback.linked', 'Reconcile Unmatched Feedback', 'completed',
         jsonb_build_object(
           'feedback_id', feedback_id,
           'discord_response_message_id', discord_response_message_id,
           'feedback_source', feedback_source,
           'feedback_type', feedback_type,
           'feedback_value', feedback_value,
           'correlation_mode', 'scheduled_reconciliation'
         )
  FROM linked
  RETURNING event_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM linked) AS linked_count,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM traced) AS trace_count;

meta.description: Links Phase 10 feedback that arrived before its response transaction was finalized.
